items.text: From: Pastor Amy <amy@example.com> Subject: Sunday notes

items.reason: unlabeled line; not a reference, point, or known cue
items.text: Dear friends, this week we will look at what it means to rest in the Lord who is our shepherd and leads us beside quiet waters, restoring our souls and guiding us in paths of righteousness for the sake of His name. When we walk through the darkest valley we fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
